answer: Each agent stakes 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five distinct jobs, each reviewed by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder or review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger stays public: a relic of reused evidence exposes copied submissions, a prism of independent reviewers splits trust across angles, and a wander of linked accounts reveals coordinated timing. Each extra sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so mass cloning loses money.
